notes: Serial isolated virtual outputs. Test-owned Kitty clients use --config NONE and sleep, not interactive shells or busy terminal contents.
GPU timer queries are asynchronous GL timestamp pairs around paintScreen; unavailable trailing samples are omitted, and idle/no-op phases can have no GPU samples.
The GPU timeline spans rendering and any command-stream waits/submission gaps; it is not summed shader execution time or presentation latency. CPU processing includes driver waits.
drawStats counts drawWindow callbacks, including recursive offscreen redirects, not unique visible windows or accurate shaded pixel counts.
The remaining live depth-dependent lag was not reproduced. Do not infer opacity alone is its cause.

Coverage clarification: zoom-burst sends events 60ms apart, below the navigator quiet threshold of 180ms. Each burst accepts one hierarchy step, so those burst/overlay-reuse results do not establish deep traversal. The later deep-out fixture verifies depth and distinct outward destinations.
